description: Na₂Mg(CoO₂)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.71 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.06 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.69 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.05 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Co atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and three Co atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Co atoms.
